title: Create Lava Chicken
description: Some KubeJS scripts that allow you to witness... Steve's lava chicken! (requires Create, KubeJS, and KubeJS create)
body:
This adds Steve's lava chicken to minecraft with the following effects:

Speed for 10 seconds. (from the bedrock edition event

1-2 hp damage from eating the lava chicken. (because it is too hot to eat)

And it gives 10 hunger points (5 hunger icons) worth of food when consumed.


To make the lava chicken, you must spout 250 mb of lava from the create spout onto raw chicken.

![Lava chicken recipe in create](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a258a9a13ce62635592decaf558f21511486f64f.png)

(Create, KubeJS, and Create KubeJS are required for this project.)
